questionText: An electron moving with speed \(5.0\times10^5\,\text{ms}^{-1}\) enters a uniform magnetic field at \(90^\circ\). Find the magnetic force. \([e=1.6\times10^{-19}\,\text{C},\;B=0.25\,\text{T}]\)
Three cells each of emf \(1.5\,\text{V}\) and internal resistance \(2.5\,\Omega\) are connected in parallel. Find the net emf and internal resistance.
explanation: Cells in parallel: emf stays \(1.5\,\text{V}\); internal resistance \(=\dfrac{2.5}{3}\approx0.83\,\Omega\)

questionText: A radioactive substance has a half-life of 20 years. What fraction of the original nuclei will decay after 80 years?
explanation: After 4 half-lives, fraction remaining \(=\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^4=\dfrac{1}{16}\). Fraction decayed \(=1-\dfrac{1}{16}=\dfrac{15}{16}\)
